scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Silent Aim, Aim bot, Fly, Speed, FOV, ESP n More
scripts.features:
This script by Fishy Hub is a comprehensive utility built on the Obsidian UI library, featuring a customizable window with Combat, ESP, and Settings tabs. The Combat section includes a Silent Aim system with adjustable FOV circle, hit-part selection (head, torso, etc.), and a movement module offering speed hacks and auto-jump/bhop. The ESP tab provides multiple visual aids such as boxes, name tags, health bars, distance displays, and tracers, each with customizable colors and a max distance slider. The Settings tab integrates a theme manager and save manager for persistent configuration, with autoload support. The script also includes a dynamic FOV circle renderer and an aimbot core that hooks the game's shooting function to redirect bullets to the nearest valid target within the FOV, respecting team and duel conditions.
